additional_info.subject: RE: ID0395310-DC/Si-D/FR-[XL2xJS] Struck at 30% CRM:00798001567
additional_info.body:
Hi Nicolas,
Such situations may arise sometimes from Software side and sometime from the Hardware side.
The Services take some time to Analyse all the components and start which take time when the memory is overwhelmed with multiple tasks.
So, Solution is the manual reboot and allow it some time to complete the booting process.
Do let us know if you have any other query.
Thank and Best Regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Giridhar "Gary"
